name: Dale: don't stare at them too long
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) with the first warning ever. The rule, said once, 10 s after the warning so it does not collide with the warning's own beat.

beats.text: Those lights you keep looking at. I wouldn't stare at them too long. Out here they notice. Over.
Dale, on the walkie: don't stare at the lights too long. Out here they notice.
